column1: # Rename table for the code generator that survives VIR (doc/quality/WORK-codegen-surviving.md).  Document only: nothing is applied by this file yet.
# Columns: old, new, kind, where, note.  Whole-word identifiers and paths, for src/tools/rename-table.py (see rename-common.tsv).
# Scope: the shared part of src/codegen/ (work queue, data objects, prepass, references, debug rows, commit), codegen/walk/, codegen/rec/, and
# from arch/a64/codegen and arch/x64/codegen what the work order keeps: record constructors, ABI, inline asm, op tables and printers, encoders,
# the tail of finish_function.  Not in it: the direct emitters scheduled for deletion (arm64's walker, x86-64's direct lowering: no quality pass,
# but a surviving name they use is renamed there too, and the note says so), codegen/opt and codegen/flow (VIR-MIGRATION step 4 decides),
#   file      path row: a src/-relative old path also moves the file with --move; a bare name (emitimpl.h) only rewrites the include forms that name it
#   function  file-scope function, static, static inline or VPRIV
#   public    declared in a header under src/include/ and used by another module
#   type      struct or union tag and typedef name (the same row renames both)
#   field     struct field; NOT applied by whole-word replace: see the last section
#   unsafe    a name a whole-word script cannot rename safely (commented out): the same word names other things in the tree
# Names follow doc/STYLE.md.  Names not renamed on purpose: (1) x86-64 functions reached through LO(name), because the macro pastes the target
# prefix (x64_mov, x64_jump, x64_label, x64_named, x64_begin, x64_finish, x64_dbgrow, x64_ecx_free, x64_classify, x64_asm and the direct
# lowering's x64_*): they and VIR's vw_NAME twins change when LO is replaced, not by this table; (2) register names of the ISAs (RAX, R8, XMM0,
# R_FP, R_LR, R_X16, R_X17, ZR, SP) and the opcodes' mnemonics are the domain's; (3) anything that appears in emitted assembly text or in a test
# expectation: the script leaves string literals alone and the files it skips; (4) the opt/ recipe types and enumerators (em_*recipe, EM_ID_*,
# EM_SWITCH_*, EM_UNUSED_*) and the walk/arm64 AST-walker-only names.
# Files that nothing mentions by path, so the script cannot rename them (git mv by hand, with the includes they have): codegen/obj.c ->
# codegen/chunk-commit.c (glossary: commit), codegen/name.h -> codegen/identifier-equal.h (the text row below handles its include), arch/a64/codegen/insn.c ->
# arch/a64/codegen/logical-immediate.c.  The files WORK-codegen-surviving.md splits or moves (func.c, obj.c of both CPUs, lower.c, print.c's twoaddr) are
# named by that order's steps and get no row here.
# Run together with the generator: src/codegen/walk/prefix.h and unprefix.h are generated by src/tools/gen-walkprefix.py from the walker's wk_*
# definitions: after the script, change the generator's DEF pattern, its error texts and the strings it writes from wk_ to walk_ (and WK_ to WALK_)
# and run it, the headers sort differently under the new names.  The rows of the WK_PREFIX family name that script too.
# Counts: 960 active rows (constant 433, file 22, function 382, function,public 1, global 17, macro 65, type 40), 73 unsafe rows (commented), 448 field rows (commented).
